@@ -0,0 +1,42 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M4NXQSMZF2TE7AP0GW9G6HM8
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8980'
+title: 'Model load telemetry: a span with phases and a load timer for MLXModelLoader'
+---
+## What
+
+A model load can take minutes (a download, then the weights), but it has no span and no metric. A load that hangs shows nothing.
+
+Files and points:
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsExtras/ModelPool/MLXModelLoader.swift`: `load(key:progressHandler:)` (`:91`), `evict(_:)` (`:112`), `footprintBytes(of:)` (`:125`). The phases: the Metal library install (`MetalLibraryBootstrap.install()`, `:94`); the download (through `ProgressReportingDownloader`, `:96`); the weights load (`loadModelContainer` in `loadLanguageModel`, `:180-191`, and `EmbedderModelFactory.shared.loadContainer` in `MLXEmbedding.load`, `:232-238`); and `model.preload()` (`:192`, LLM only).
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsExtras/ModelPool/ModelPool.swift`: `load(_:footprintBytes:sessionBytes:loader:)` (`:210`) and `loadMeasured(_:)` (`:230`) call the loader.
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsExtras/ModelPool/PooledModel.swift`: `prewarm(transcript:)` (`:106`) drops its error with `try?` (`:108`).
+
+Approach (each name in `ExtrasTelemetry.swift`, metric objects made at call time):
+- Span `FoundationModelsExtras.model.load` through `TracedCall`, so that a hung load has an "enter" record. Open it in the pool (`load`/`loadMeasured`), so that each loader gets it. Attributes: `model.ref`, `model.revision`, `model.role` (`llm` or `embedding`).
+- Child spans in `MLXModelLoader` for the Metal library install, the download (attribute `download.bytes`, from the completed bytes that the progress handler gets), the weights load, and `preload()`.
+- Timers `model.load.duration` and `model.evict.duration` with `model.ref`, `model.role` and the outcome (`succeeded` or `failed`).
+- Recorder `model.footprint.bytes` with `model.ref` and `model.role`, from `footprintBytes(of:)` or the measured bytes in `loadMeasured`.
+- `prewarm`: replace the silent `try?` with a `do`/`catch` that writes one log record with `error.type` (`ExtrasTelemetry.errorType`) and `model.ref`.
+- Never record a file path, a cache folder, a URL or `error.localizedDescription`.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] Each pool load opens one `FoundationModelsExtras.model.load` span with `model.ref`, `model.revision` and `model.role`, and writes one "enter" log record.
+- [ ] `MLXModelLoader` opens a child span for each phase that runs (Metal install, download, weights load, and `preload()` for an LLM).
+- [ ] Each load and each eviction records one duration on `model.load.duration` or `model.evict.duration` with the outcome. Each measured load records `model.footprint.bytes`.
+- [ ] A `prewarm` that fails writes one log record with `error.type` and no description.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsExtrasTests/ModelPool/ModelPoolTests.swift`: with a fake loader from `ModelPoolTestSupport.swift`, `W3CInMemoryTracer` and `MetricsTestKit` `TestMetrics`, test the load span, the attributes, the load and evict timers for a load that succeeds and a load that fails, and the footprint recorder.
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsExtrasTests/ModelPool/PooledModelTests.swift`: a `prewarm` that throws writes one log record with `error.type`. A content-safety test with `TelemetryCapture.run(forbidding:)` that forbids the cache path.
+- [ ] One integration test in `IntegrationTests/Tests/FoundationModelsExtrasIntegrationTests/MLXModelLoaderIntegrationTests.swift` that loads the real model and checks the load span and its phase child spans.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes with no warnings.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
+
+#telemetry #feature
\ No newline at end of file
